% Source-backed regression for waveform-source geometry inside a circuit.
\documentclass[border=2pt]{standalone}
\usepackage{circuitikz}
\ctikzset{
  sources/fill=orange!14,
  bipoles/vsourcesquare/width=.8,
  bipoles/vsourcesquare/height=1.05,
  bipoles/vsourcetri/width=.55,
  bipoles/vsourcetri/height=.85
}
\begin{document}
\begin{circuitikz}[thick]
  \draw (0,0) to[square voltage source,l_=$V_{\mathrm{pulse}}$] (0,3)
        -- (3,3) to[R,l=$R$] (3,0) -- (0,0);
  \draw (5,0) to[triangle voltage source,l_=$V_{\mathrm{ramp}}$] (5,3)
        -- (8,3) to[C,l=$C$] (8,0) -- (5,0);
\end{circuitikz}
\end{document}
